CREATE TABLE #TEMP_TBL
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = HASH(CUST_ID)
,    HEAP
)
AS
SELECT
    AS_OF_DATE
    ,CUST_ID
    ,GAM_ACID
    ,ACCT_CRNCY_CODE
    ,GAM_BANK_ID
    ,GAM_SCHM_TYPE
    ,GAM_SCHM_CODE
    ,OUTSTANDING_BALANCE
    ,OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP
    ,DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS
    ,ACCT_CLS_DATE
FROM EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT
where ACCT_CRNCY_CODE <> 'PHP'
 
UNION ALL
 
SELECT
    AS_OF_DATE
    ,CUST_ID
    ,GAM_ACID
    ,ACCT_CRNCY_CODE
    ,GAM_BANK_ID
    ,GAM_SCHM_TYPE
    ,GAM_SCHM_CODE
    ,OUTSTANDING_BALANCE
    ,OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP
    ,DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS
    ,ACCT_CLS_DATE
FROM D360.DEPOSIT_FACT_TEST_20231229
WHERE ACCT_CRNCY_CODE <> 'PHP'
;

DROP TABLE EDS.DEPOSIT_NONPHP_YTD;

CREATE TABLE EDS.DEPOSIT_NONPHP_YTD
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = HASH(CUST_ID)
,    HEAP
)
AS
SELECT 
      TMP.FULLDATE
    , TMP.Previous_Business_Day
    , TMP.CUST_ID
    , TMP.GAM_ACID
    , TMP.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE
    , TMP.GAM_BANK_ID
    , TMP.GAM_SCHM_TYPE
    , (CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE ELSE CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE END) AS CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE
    , (CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP ELSE CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP END) AS CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP
    , CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE AS PREVIOUS_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE
    , CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP AS PREVIOUS_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP
    , CASE WHEN TMP.FULLDATE >= CURRENT_BD.ACCT_CLS_DATE THEN 0
      ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE ELSE CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE END)
        OVER(PARTITION BY YEAR, TMP.CUST_ID, TMP.GAM_ACID ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) END AS TOTAL_CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE --
    , CASE WHEN TMP.FULLDATE >= CURRENT_BD.ACCT_CLS_DATE THEN 0 
      ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP ELSE CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP END)
        OVER(PARTITION BY YEAR, TMP.CUST_ID, TMP.GAM_ACID ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) END AS TOTAL_CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP --
    , DAYOFYEAR
    , SUM(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE ELSE CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE END)
      OVER(PARTITION BY YEAR, TMP.CUST_ID, TMP.GAM_ACID ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) / DAYOFYEAR AS YTD_BALANCE
    , SUM(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP ELSE CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP END)
        OVER(PARTITION BY YEAR, TMP.CUST_ID, TMP.GAM_ACID ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) / DAYOFYEAR AS YTD_BALANCE_PHP
    , TMP.MONTH_END
 
FROM
    (
        SELECT FULLDATE
            , Previous_Business_Day
            , Business_Day_Flag
            , DAYOFYEAR
            , YEAR
            , CUST_ID
            , GAM_ACID
            , ACCT_CRNCY_CODE
            , GAM_BANK_ID
            , GAM_SCHM_TYPE
            , MONTH_END
            , ACCT_CLS_DATE
        FROM EDS.DATE_DIM
        JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT
            ON 1 = 1
            AND SUBSTRING(GAM_SCHM_CODE, 1, 2) <> '09'
            AND ACCT_CRNCY_CODE <> 'PHP'
	        AND (AS_OF_DATE = '2024-07-12' OR (DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS = 'C' and  AS_OF_DATE >= '2024-01-01'))
        WHERE FULLDATE BETWEEN CAST ('20231229' AS DATE) AND CAST ('20240717' AS DATE)
    ) TMP
LEFT JOIN #TEMP_TBL CURRENT_BD
    ON TMP.CUST_ID = CURRENT_BD.CUST_ID
        AND TMP.FULLDATE = CURRENT_BD.AS_OF_DATE
        AND TMP.GAM_ACID = CURRENT_BD.GAM_ACID
LEFT JOIN #TEMP_TBL CURRENT_PBD
    ON TMP.CUST_ID = CURRENT_PBD.CUST_ID
        AND TMP.Previous_Business_Day = CURRENT_PBD.AS_OF_DATE
        AND TMP.GAM_ACID = CURRENT_PBD.GAM_ACID;

INSERT INTO EDS.DEPOSIT_NONPHP_YTD
(
FULLDATE
,Previous_Business_Day
,CUST_ID
,GAM_ACID
,ACCT_CRNCY_CODE
,GAM_BANK_ID
,GAM_SCHM_TYPE
,CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE
,CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP
,PREVIOUS_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE
,PREVIOUS_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP
,TOTAL_CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE
,TOTAL_CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP
,DAYOFYEAR
,YTD_BALANCE
,YTD_BALANCE_PHP
,MONTH_END
)

SELECT
    A.CURRENT_EOD_DATE AS FULLDATE
    , NULL AS Previous_Business_Day
    , B.CUST_ID AS CUST_ID
    , A.ACID AS GAM_ACID
    , B.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE
    , A.BANK_ID AS GAM_BANK_ID
    , NULL AS GAM_SCHM_TYPE
    , NULL AS CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE
    , NULL AS CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP
    , NULL AS PREVIOUS_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE
    , NULL AS PREVIOUS_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP
    , A.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL AS TOTAL_CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE
    , A.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL AS TOTAL_CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP
    , C.DAYOFYEAR
    , A.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL/C.DAYOFYEAR AS YTD_BALANCE
    , A.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL/C.DAYOFYEAR AS YTD_BALANCE_PHP
    , 'Y' AS MONTH_END
    FROM
        (SELECT *
            ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CURRENT_EOD_DATE, ACID, BANK_ID ORDER BY ACID) RN
            FROM busc.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES
            WHERE CURRENT_EOD_DATE IN ('2023-12-29', '2024-02-29')
                AND BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
            ) A
        JOIN (SELECT GAM_ACID, ACCT_CRNCY_CODE, GAM_BANK_ID, CUST_ID FROM eds.DEPOSIT_FACT GROUP BY GAM_ACID, ACCT_CRNCY_CODE, GAM_BANK_ID, CUST_ID) B
            ON A.ACID = B.GAM_ACID
            AND A.BANK_ID = B.GAM_BANK_ID
            AND B.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP'
        LEFT JOIN eds.DATE_DIM C
            ON A.CURRENT_EOD_DATE = C.FULLDATE
    WHERE A.RN = 1
